OTM Games

Games you paste into your browser's console. Pick one, copy the code, play anywhere.

Choose a game below to get its code.↓

OTM Stickman Fight

v11.1

Bring your own game: no games are included. Press Load ROM (or drop a file on the window) and pick a .gba file of a game you own, or a free homebrew game. Your in-game saves stay in your browser, and Save ↓ downloads them.

Bring your own game: no games are included. Press Load ROM (or drop a file on the window) and pick a .sfc or .smc file of a game you own, or a free homebrew game. Your in-game saves stay in your browser, and Save ↓ downloads them. Games with extra chips inside the cartridge (Star Fox, Super Mario Kart, Yoshi's Island) don't work yet.

Moribund is a full game page, so there's no console code to copy. Press ▶ Play to open it. Use headphones, and click the game so the mouse can look around. Your save files stay in your browser.

/open line engine uses your webcam to track your hands. Press ▶ Play, then Turn on camera and allow it. Keys: 1 strings · 2 window · 3 laser · 4 all · F filter · S skeleton · C customize how everything looks. The video stays on your computer. School computers might block the camera.

Godspeed 💤 Good Try is a 3D movement game. Press ▶ Play (or copy the code and paste it into the console on any site), click the game so the mouse can look around, walk around the lobby, then walk into the bed in the middle to pick SLEEP (an endless path, nothing can hurt you) or SLEEPRUNNING (rounds: reach the bed at the end before the timer runs out, then rest in the pink room). WASD move · Space jump · C/Ctrl slide · R checkpoint (change them in ⌨ Keybinds). Jump again while touching a wall to wall jump. Slide-jumps and wall jumps keep your speed. The further you get, the more things hunt you. Reach the bed at the end and sleep.

Big Time is a calculator you can open on any website. Press ▶ Open here to try it, or copy the code and paste it into the console. Hover over it to type: Enter is =, Backspace deletes, Esc clears. Drag it by the title, and ✕ closes it. It does ( ), ^ powers, √, %, π and ! too. Press MODE to switch to 7th grade helpers (distributive property, like terms, equations, inequalities, fractions, percents, proportions, circles, area, angles, stats and probability). They show every step.

Pasting it: this version has everything, including online play. Paste it on a website (example.com works best), then click Play → 🌐 Online. One person hosts and gets a 4-letter code, the other types it in. No accounts needed. Some websites and school WiFi block online play.

  1. Go to any website (for example IXL or Google).
  2. Open the console: Ctrl + Shift + J (Chromebook and Windows) or ⌘ + ⌥ + J (Mac).
  3. Paste the code and press Enter.

▶ Play here runs the game right on this page. To play a friend online, click Play → 🌐 Online: one person hosts and gets a 4-letter code, the other types it in. No accounts needed. Press Esc to come back.

First time? Chrome may block pasting. Type allow pasting in the console, press Enter, then paste again.
